DEC-318 board revision — protect-the-engine rebalance: 3 hydra-shell adds restored (Wan Shi Tong, Brass Infiniscope, Goldvein Hydra), removal trimmed (5 spot → 2, 3 wipes → 2), 4 protection/draw adds (Inspiring Call, Tamiyo's Safekeeping, Veil of Summer, Guardian Project), 2 counter accelerators (Hardened Scales, Hangarback Walker-style threats via Wildwood Scourge/Hooded Hydra deferred — see synergies)
Scryfall — id<=gu mana:{x} edhrec-ordered sweep + Strixhaven SOC/SOS X-payoff cluster

DEC-318 board-approved swaps (run 2026-06-01): +Foil (cut Veil of Summer — counters answer broader threats than narrow hexproof); +Curse of the Swine (cut Hedron Archive — restored the dedicated creature wipe Pest Infestation does not provide; ramp slot dropped because 2-mana ramp suite is sufficient). Also corrected Cyclonic Rift / Pest Infestation rationale: Rift is overload {6}{U} (not X) bouncing every opponent's nonland perms; Pest Infestation destroys artifacts/enchantments (not creatures) and creates 2X Pest tokens.

DEC-318 board-approved swap (run 2026-06-01, post-audit): +Hullbreaker Horror (cut Paradox Surveyor — weakest X-payoff trigger). Hullbreaker is a third combo finisher path: its 'whenever you cast a spell' trigger fires off each Reversal copy in the Scepter loop, giving zero-marginal-cost bounces of opponents' permanents OR spells on the stack (option 1 also pre-empts opposing counters during the combo turn). Uncounterable, flash, 7/8 — also serves as a beatdown body if the combo line stalls.

DEC-331 board-approved mana-base rebalance (2026-06-05): drop resource-denial + over-fetched base. Cuts: Strip Mine, Wasteland (board: deck identity is not LD), Scalding Tarn, Flooded Strand, Verdant Catacombs, Wooded Foothills, Polluted Delta (fetches trimmed from 7 to 2 — kept Misty Rainforest + Prismatic Vista). Adds: +1 Forest, +2 Island, Halimar Depths (top-3 stack pairs with Sensei's Top / Sylvan Library / tutors), Simic Growth Chamber (UG dual; bounce-replay is fine at 35 lands), Path of Ancestry (UG fixing + scry on Human/Wizard creature casts — Zimone shares those types), Llanowar Reborn (Graft places +1/+1 counters on creature ETBs, synergises with Zimone counter math and Hardened Scales).

DEC-331 board-approved X-density add (2026-06-05): +Pull from Tomorrow ({X}{U}{U} instant — Draw X, discard 1) / -Mystic Remora. Pull is the 19th X-spell, the only instant-speed Draw-X in UG at this budget; fires on opponents' EOT to refuel during combo windows and triggers Zimone at instant speed. Mystic Remora's 3-turn taxing window is dead late and competes for the same enchantment-resource slot as Rhystic Study (kept).
DEC-331 board-approved ownership swap (2026-06-05): Llanowar Elves → Fyndhorn Elves (strict functional reprint — {G} 1/1 Elf Druid, '{T}: Add {G}.'). Identical cost, color, type, ability.

DEC-331 board-approved illegal-land fix (2026-06-05): -Lush Portico / +Flooded Grove. Lush Portico is Forest/Plains color identity {G}{W} — illegal in this {U}{G} deck (residual from DEC-318 baseline, missed in the prior mana-base sweep). Flooded Grove is the strict mana upgrade: ETB untapped filter land, '{G/U}, {T}: Add {G}{G}, {G}{U}, or {U}{U}.' — pays {U}{U} for Counterspell or {G}{G} for hydra X-spells. Board owns one spare. Ash Barrens retained per board for landcycling into an Island enabling Foil's exile-blue-card alt-cost.

guideContent.strategyOverview: Calculated Infinity is the X-Storm + protect-the-engine build of Zimone, Infinite Analyst — a B4- Simic deck whose primary plan is to grow Zimone via X-spells (she gains 2 +1/+1 counters per X-spell cast, and discounts the first X-spell each turn by {1} per counter on her), then close with a chain of giant X-spells. Zimone is the engine, so the deck leans into protection (Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Heroic Intervention, Inspiring Call, Tamiyo's Safekeeping, Foil counter, Riptide Laboratory bounce) over heavy removal — once Zimone has 4+ counters, the next Stroke of Genius / Hydroid Krasis / Primordial Hydra cast at X=6+ snowballs the game. Secondary kill is the Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter + ≥3 mana of rocks combo finishing through Walking Ballista at X=arbitrary, with Aetherflux Reservoir as the storm finisher. Combat Plan B is Primordial Hydra + Vorinclex (counter-doubling) over 2-3 turns. The X-creature suite (Wan Shi Tong, Goldvein Hydra, Primordial Hydra, Hydroid Krasis, Genesis Hydra, Voracious Hydra, Walking Ballista) is intentionally redundant: every X creature is itself a draw/protection/removal payoff or leaves resilient tokens/treasure on death. Counter doublers (Hardened Scales, Vorinclex) amplify Zimone's growth into one-turn lethal windows. Removal is trimmed to 2 spot pieces (Beast Within, Rapid Hybridization) + 3 wipes (Cyclonic Rift's overload bouncing all opponents' nonland perms, Pest Infestation hitting artifacts/enchantments + making 2X Pest tokens, Curse of the Swine as the dedicated X-cost creature exile) — Boseiju/Otawara channel modes and the modal X-creatures (Voracious Hydra, Walking Ballista) cover the rest. NO Force of Will / Ancient Tomb / Grim Monolith / Mana Vault / Chrome Mox per board exclusion — Soft B4 / B4- target, not True B4.

deckCategories.name: Commander Engine
deckCategories.description: Zimone discounts the first X-spell each turn by {1} per counter on her; gains 2 counters per X-spell cast.

deckCategories.name: Primary Combo Line
deckCategories.description: Dramatic Reversal imprinted on Isochron Scepter + 3+ mana of rocks (Sol Ring + Simic Signet + Brass Infiniscope, plus any Elementalist's Palette / Troyan / dorks) = infinite mana + infinite Reversal casts (each Scepter activation casts a copy). Walking Ballista cast for X=arbitrary closes the game.

deckCategories.name: Backup Combo — Aetherflux Reservoir
deckCategories.description: Aetherflux on the battlefield converts the Scepter loop into damage: each Reversal copy is a cast, triggers Aetherflux for cumulative N+1 life. N=17 → 153 life → pay 50 three times → one-shot the table.

deckCategories.name: Backup Combo — Hullbreaker Horror
deckCategories.description: Flash 7/8 Kraken Horror, can't be countered. Whenever you cast a spell, optionally bounce a target nonland permanent OR target spell you don't control. In the Scepter loop, each Reversal copy is a cast → Hullbreaker triggers → bounce one thing per cycle, zero per-bounce mana cost. Crucially, the spell-bounce mode eats opposing counters mid-combo turn, making the line resilient to instant-speed disruption. Also a 7/8 beatdown body if combo stalls.

deckCategories.name: Tutors
deckCategories.description: Find the missing combo piece. Drift of Phantasms transmutes for MV=3 cards (Eternal Witness, Inspiring Call, Counterspell-with-X, etc.). Genesis Hydra hits any permanent.

deckCategories.name: Free Counters
deckCategories.description: Protect Zimone and the combo turn without spending mana. Four-piece suite focused on the highest-impact saves (Fierce Guardianship is free with commander out; Pact of Negation hard-counters key threats; Swan Song hits enchantments/instants/sorceries; Foil counters ANY spell for the cost of discarding an Island + 1 other card — very playable with 6 Island-typed cards in the manabase).

deckCategories.name: Paid Counters
deckCategories.description: Standard counter package for mid-game disruption. Repulsive Mutation doubles as +1/+1 counters on Zimone — counts as her first X-spell of the turn.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Engines
deckCategories.description: Amplify Zimone's discount, copy X-spell payoffs, or accelerate her counter growth. Unbound Flourishing is the deck's most important enchantment after the combo pieces; Hardened Scales adds +1 counter per Zimone trigger (2 → 3) and pumps every X-creature on entry.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Payoff Triggers
deckCategories.description: Loot / tutor / scry on each X-spell cast. Smooth the build-around dependency. Brass Infiniscope ramps {C}{C} AND draws + gains life on the next X-spell — the deck's best 4-mana payoff.

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Finishers (Storm-style)
deckCategories.description: Castable in chains via infinite mana from the combo line, OR mid-game via Zimone discount. Genesis Wave is a mana acceleration / setup spell, NOT a wincon (X-cost hydras die on entry per CR 706.10).

deckCategories.name: X-Spell Threats
deckCategories.description: Cast normally for value. Wan Shi Tong is a flash flier that enters with X counters and draws X/2 cards — best mid-game tempo X-creature in U, and a punisher whenever any opponent tutors. Goldvein Hydra gives back X Treasures on death (built-in resilience + ramp). Primordial Hydra is the combat Plan B; Hydroid Krasis is the value finisher (life + draw on cast); Walking Ballista is both wincon and modal removal; Genesis Hydra is a tutor + body; Voracious Hydra doubles as fight removal.

deckCategories.name: Board Wipes
deckCategories.description: Three wipes, each covering a different axis. Cyclonic Rift's overload cost ({6}{U}, NOT X) bounces every nonland permanent you don't control — universal nonland sweep across all opponents. Pest Infestation ({X}{X}{G}) destroys up to X artifacts/enchantments AND creates 2X 1/1 Pest tokens — artifact/enchantment sweeper + token engine, not a creature wipe. Curse of the Swine ({X}{U}{U}) is the dedicated creature wipe — exile X target creatures across any opponents (asymmetric: you choose targets), with each player getting X 2/2 Boar tokens.

deckCategories.name: Spot Removal
deckCategories.description: Trimmed to 2 dedicated pieces — the deck's plan is to grow Zimone and X-blast, not to point-and-click answer every threat. Beast Within and Rapid Hybridization cover commanders, planeswalkers, and lands cleanly; Walking Ballista/Voracious Hydra/Boseiju/Otawara round out modal removal.

deckCategories.name: Commander Protection
deckCategories.description: Zimone is the engine — losing her resets the counter clock and costs the discount snowball. Five-piece suite covers different removal vectors: haste/shroud equipment (Greaves), repeatable hexproof equipment (Boots), pinpoint hexproof+indestructible (Tamiyo's Safekeeping), team indestructible + draw-on-counters (Inspiring Call), and team hexproof (Heroic Intervention). Riptide Laboratory in the land base bounces Zimone to dodge wipes/exile. Free Counters (Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Swan Song, Foil) cover the stack-based protection layer.

deckCategories.name: Ramp
deckCategories.description: 8 pieces. Standard signets + dorks + 2-mana land tutors + Troyan/Palette as X-mana faucets. One 1-mana dork (Fyndhorn Elves) is sufficient alongside Birds of Paradise — saved a slot for the X-payoff package. Hedron Archive intentionally omitted: the 2-mana ramp suite is sufficient, and the slot is better spent on creature interaction (Curse of the Swine).

deckCategories.name: Card Draw + Selection
deckCategories.description: Repeatable engines outside the X-spell loop. Guardian Project draws on each unique creature ETB — pays off the diverse X-creature suite. Sensei's Top + Sylvan Library smooth tutor finds; Rhystic Study taxes opponents into bleeding cards; Pull from Tomorrow is the instant-speed Draw-X refuel that doubles as the 19th X-spell for Zimone.

deckCategories.name: Recursion
deckCategories.description: Recur a key X-spell from the yard. Auroral Procession + Eternal Witness cover the value-incremental recursion floor (per docs/deck-metrics.md).

synergies.title: Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter + ≥3 mana of rocks = infinite mana + infinite casts
synergies.description: Imprint Dramatic Reversal on Isochron Scepter. Activate Scepter for {2}: cast Reversal copy, untap all nonland permanents (including the Scepter and all rocks). Tap Sol Ring (2) + Simic Signet (1 net) + Brass Infiniscope (1) plus any additional rock/dork = 4+ mana, minus 2 Scepter cost = 2+ net per cycle. With Elementalist's Palette or Troyan online the loop scales much faster. Infinite mana and infinite Reversal casts.

synergies.title: Aetherflux Reservoir + Scepter loop = lethal life-pay chain
synergies.description: With Aetherflux on the battlefield, each Scepter activation casts a Reversal copy (per Scepter oracle: 'you may cast the copy'). Aetherflux triggers on each cast for cumulative life: N(N+1)/2 after N iterations. N=17 = 153 life → pay 50 three times = 150 damage = one-shot table.

synergies.title: Zimone + Unbound Flourishing — discount-and-copy X engine
synergies.description: Zimone discounts first X-spell each turn by {1} per counter. Unbound Flourishing doubles X on permanent X-spells AND copies X-cost instants/sorceries. Cast Hydroid Krasis for X=6 with Zimone at 4 counters → pay {2}{G}{U}, 12/12 trampler, gain 12 life, draw 12 cards.

synergies.title: Vorinclex + Zimone — stacked counter growth
synergies.description: Vorinclex doubles counters you place on permanents. Zimone gains 2 counters per X-spell → with Vorinclex, 4 counters per X-spell. After 2 X-spells, Zimone discounts {8} on the next first-X-spell.

synergies.title: Drift of Phantasms transmutes for MV-3 protection or finisher
synergies.description: Drift transmutes {2}{U}{U} for any MV-3 card. In-deck MV-3 hits include Inspiring Call (commander protection + draw), Eternal Witness (recursion), Counterspell, Beast Within, Rapid Hybridization-with-X, and Branching Evolution-class doublers. The transmute is now a protection/utility tutor, not a combo-piece tutor (Reversal and Scepter are both MV 2 — miss).

sources.name: DEC-318 board revision — Drift role re-scoped

synergies.title: Wan Shi Tong + Zimone — X-creature draw engine
synergies.description: Wan Shi Tong is a {X}{U}{U} flash flier that enters with X +1/+1 counters and draws X/2 cards. Cast as Zimone's first X-spell of the turn with Zimone at 3 counters: pay {X}{U}{U}-{3} = effectively X for {U}{U}. At X=4, Wan Shi Tong is a 4/4 flash flier that draws 2 + Zimone grows by 2. Doubles as an opponent-tutor punisher: any time an opponent cracks a fetch / Demonic Tutor / Vampiric Tutor, Wan Shi Tong gains a counter and you draw a card.

synergies.title: Brass Infiniscope — colorless ramp into X-payoff
synergies.description: {4} artifact, {T}: add {C}{C}. When you next cast an X-spell this turn, draw 1 + gain X/2 life. Pairs with Zimone's discount: tap Infiniscope for {C}{C}, then cast Hydroid Krasis or Stroke for X=6 → Krasis 6/6 + draw 6 + gain 6 + Infiniscope triggers for +1 draw and 3 life on top.

synergies.title: Goldvein Hydra — X-spell that ramps on death
synergies.description: {X}{G} hydra with vigilance/trample/haste, enters with X counters, dies → X Treasures. Built-in resilience: even when removed, leaves X mana of Treasures to fuel the next X-spell. With Zimone discount + Vorinclex doubling, Goldvein for X=4 enters as an 8/8 (Vorinclex), and on death yields 8 Treasures — enough to cast Stroke of Genius for X=8 or Walking Ballista for X=8.

synergies.title: Hardened Scales + Zimone — counter acceleration
synergies.description: Hardened Scales adds +1 to every +1/+1 counter event on your creatures. Zimone's 'put two +1/+1 counters on her' becomes 3. After 2 X-spells, Zimone is at 6 counters instead of 4 — discounts the next first-X-spell by {6}. Hardened Scales also pumps every X-creature on entry: Hooded Hydra for X=3 enters as a 4/4 instead of 3/3, Goldvein Hydra for X=4 enters as a 5/5 (and dies for 5 Treasures).

synergies.title: Inspiring Call + Zimone — protection + draw scaling with counters
synergies.description: {2}{G} instant: draw a card for each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter, those creatures gain indestructible until end of turn. With Zimone (always counted, +1/+1 from first X-spell) + 2-3 X-creatures on board, Inspiring Call draws 3-4 cards AND saves the entire counter-grown board from a wipe. Zimone is the engine — this is the single best protection card for her.

synergies.title: Repulsive Mutation — counter their spell + grow Zimone
synergies.description: Put X +1/+1 counters on Zimone, then counter target spell unless its controller pays mana equal to greatest power on your side. Counts as Zimone's first X-spell — adds 2 more counters. Repulsive for X=3 with Zimone at 4 counters: Zimone goes 4 → 9 (4+3+2). Next X-spell discounts by {9}.

synergies.title: Owlin Spiralmancer + first X-spell = double cast each turn
synergies.description: Owlin copies the first X-spell you cast each turn. Stacks with Unbound Flourishing's copy ability: cast one Stroke of Genius for X=4 → Unbound copies → Owlin copies the original. Three Stroke resolutions for one paid cast.

synergies.title: Primo + Zimone (0 power) = Fractal token engine
synergies.description: Primo: 'Whenever one or more creatures you control with base power 0 deal combat damage to a player, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.' Zimone has base power 0. Each combat she connects = a Fractal token sized to damage dealt. With Lightning Greaves + Zimone at 8+ counters = ~8-12 damage per swing = 8-12/8-12 Fractal token.

synergies.title: Auroral Procession — rebuy a finisher
synergies.description: Auroral Procession is a {G}{U} instant returning any card from your graveyard to your hand. Recurs Stroke of Genius for a second mill, Genesis Wave for a second mana-explosion, or Aetherflux Reservoir if removed.

winConditions.title: Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter + rocks → Walking Ballista lethal
winConditions.description: Assemble Scepter+Reversal+ ≥3 mana of rocks for infinite mana. Cast Walking Ballista for X=arbitrary; enters with X +1/+1 counters; remove counters to ping each opponent to 0.

winConditions.title: Scepter loop + Aetherflux Reservoir = pay-50 chain
winConditions.description: With Aetherflux on battlefield before combo turn: each Scepter activation casts a Reversal copy (per oracle); Aetherflux triggers per cast for cumulative N+1 life. N=17 iterations = 153 life gained → 193 total life → pay 50 three times = 150 damage = one-shot table.

winConditions.title: Stroke of Genius mill-out with infinite mana
winConditions.description: Alternative finisher when Walking Ballista is in library: cast Stroke of Genius for X = each opponent's library size. Mill them out. Repeat per opponent with infinite mana.

winConditions.title: Primordial Hydra + Vorinclex combat (Plan B)
winConditions.description: Slow fallback if combo is countered repeatedly. Cast Primordial Hydra for X=6 (with Zimone discount = ~3 mana). Vorinclex doubles upkeep doubling → 6/6 → 24/24 → 96/96. Two combat turns lethal on one opponent.
